scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking on the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. Your loan has been originated. Is there anything else you would like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user: Oh, great! I'm glad to hear that. Could you tell me what my interest rate is? And also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.875%. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and does not have any negative amortization features. Is there anything else you would like to know?

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. What are the total costs of this loan? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The total costs of this loan are not available in the record. Your loan has been sold to another institution, but the record does not specify the type of purchaser. Is there anything else you would like to know?

dialogue.user: I see. What type of loan product was I approved for? And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product. Your debt-to-income ratio is between 50%-60%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying your debts. Is there anything else you would like to know?

dialogue.user:
No, I think that covers everything I needed to know. Thank you for your help!

<Very Satisfied> The agent was very helpful and answered all of my questions clearly and politely. I feel well-informed about my loan.
